15.t: Working with data: pressure under shoes
q: In which footwear did the student sink most?
Calculate the pressure under the trainers.
Predict how far the student sank in bare feet, with a reason.
About 15 mm: the pressure (30 000 Pa) is between trainers (20 000, 12 mm) and heels (300 000, 45 mm), closer to trainers.
Explain why plane tyres for soft runways are wide.
A wide tyre spreads the weight over a bigger area, so the pressure is lower and the wheels do not sink into soft ground.
